rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Chunk 4 raw line 22 now reads 'the lecture ahead hands you the lenses to read it with' (was 'the lecture below' before this diff-region's chunk-5 insertion moved the two lecture links one chunk further away). 'Ahead' is on the compendium's own §12 reading-order fix list ('next, coming up, that follow') -- it claims only sequence, not spatial adjacency, so it survives the intervening chunk 5 the way 'below' could not. Adversarial case considered: a reader could still expect the very next slide to BE the lecture and feel the promise miss when chunk 5 (an unrelated done-done beat) intervenes first. This does not hold against the rule as written -- §12's harm is a pointer that 'aims at a wall' once geometry is lost, and 'ahead' aims at the reading order, which is intact: the two lecture links do arrive, at the tail of the very next chunk, still forward of where the claim was made. The fix matches the fix_hint recorded on the superseded body_sha 9b474ead... version of this same instance file (same suggested wording, 'the lecture ahead'), applied verbatim.
